label: Sheep and goats identification and traceability
description: Sheep, lambs, goats, and caprines identification using electronic ear tags, RFID tags, tattoos, paint marks, and movement records. Covers traceability, grazing system management, disease surveillance, and outbreak response including Scrapie, Foot and Mouth Disease, and Bluetongue.
